notes: Paper contact inferred from user stopping at first light drag per calibration instructions.
Earlier cross-X measurements are provisional and must not be used for twist correction: axes lost trusted position during idle.
At acceptance, Configuration.h default was updated to -0.68. Historical test files change runtime M851 only and do not save EEPROM.

trials.result: User reports much more uniform appearance, but parallel lines separate with almost no force. Photos show gaps between strands. Working diagnosis: first-layer gap too large; not final calibration.
Improved bonding compared with -0.61; user reports localized light-transmitting gaps remain, but strands are harder to separate. No final calibration established.
User chose to stop tuning at this result; runtime M851 confirmed X-44.10 Y-3.30 Z-0.68. Accepted as the working offset. No claim of a perfectly uniform layer.

persistence.incident: M501 with active bilinear leveling corrupted RAM Z/count to INT32_MAX; saved offset and mesh survived.
persistence.recovery: User fully power-cycled the board and USB. M114 X0 Y0 Z0 Count0, M851 Z-0.68 and saved full grid verified. Leveling OFF.
